reviews.title: Important Feedback for FanCode App Improvements
reviews.text:
Hey FanCode Developers,

I have some important feedback regarding the app that I'd like to share.

Firstly, why is this app not available for Apple TV 4K users? It's 2026, and with tvOS being around for quite some time, it would be great to see you invest in a version for the Apple TV 4K. This could really enhance the user experience for those of us who prefer watching content on Apple TV.

Secondly, please provide a proper option to manage subscriptions and payment information directly within the app. Users need a clear way to subscribe, unsubscribe, and add or delete payment information. Currently, it seems quite limited and almost shady that there aren’t straightforward options for managing this, both in the app and web app.

Lastly, I suggest refining the UI/UX. A more responsive design that makes it easy to find content tailored to user interests would significantly improve the experience.

Thank you for considering this feedback! I look forward to seeing improvements in future updates.

I once thought how can an App be so bad (about the JioHotstar app). FanCode went a step beyond and proved that things can be even worse.
It will load the ads perfectly fine, but as soon as the ad ends and it’s time to show the F1 race, suddenly it asks me to refresh, on doing so, again the ad will load perfectly fine but the race won’t. It’s an endless loop of refreshing, watching an Ad and then again refreshing.

Nothing has helped, neither restarting the app nor reinstalling it. Changing from Wi-Fi to mobile data didn’t help either.

And on top of all that, the customer service is so bad it makes the app look better., they will reply with the generic, restart the app, restart the device, change your net (as if I’m gonna change the Wi-Fi services because their app can’t do what it is supposed to do). On telling them I have done all the things mentioned already, they will start gaslighting me into thinking the problem is with either my phone or my Wi-Fi.

Oh yeah, on the off chance that the F1 race actually does load by some miracle, the PiP can somehow read my mind and won’t work when I want it to work, and will work when I don’t want it to. Like just be consistent, either work everytime or don’t .

And please don’t reply to contact you via mail, I already did and you guys were useless.

Apps like these will make the piracy win the piracy wars.
